notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence medium): Benilla ships the full Interface/Cursor BLP set as a hardware cursor driven by the targeting classifier (Point default, Attack over hostiles, Speak/Buy/Trainer/Taxi over service NPCs, Loot/Skin over corpses, grayed Unable* twins out of range) plus the held drag payload's item icon as the cursor. MSUI draws Interface/Cursor art at the mouse in specific UI contexts - Buy/UnableBuy over vendor rows, Repair in repair mode, Inspect for readables - and draws the carried item's icon at the cursor while dragging, but the world cursor is the plain OS arrow everywhere.
